close_reason: Won't fix — Cargo automatically defaults documentation to docs.rs/<name>. Marked opinion-grade in the original finding.
description:
All 25 Cargo.toml manifests lack `documentation = "https://docs.rs/<name>"`. Cargo automatically defaults to docs.rs/<name> when omitted, so this is cosmetic — the docs.rs link works either way.

Most established crates set it explicitly anyway (RustCrypto, tokio, serde) so that the value is visible in `cargo metadata` output and on the crates.io page header.

Marked opinion: not a publish blocker, debatable whether worth setting. Convergence eligible.
title: P3: documentation field absent on all 25 crates
